ov: The common buzzard is a medium-sized bird of prey found across most of Europe and east into Asia, and probably the most common daytime raptor in Europe. It mostly hunts voles and other rodents from a perch.
rg: Most of Europe and east to western Siberia, Mongolia and China; northern and eastern birds winter as far south as South Africa.
df: Mostly small mammals, especially voles; an opportunist that takes many other prey.

cf.tip: In the US, buzzards of this group are called hawks.

fx: Up to 30 buzzards have been seen foraging on the ground in a single large field.
